design: general evidence scope and score admission
title: Define score admission separately from complete specification acceptance
pattern: A source-bound review records multiple plausible interpretations without proving a candidate defect, while a batch coordinator treats the unresolved specification question as a global scoring prerequisite; otherwise evaluable frozen candidates never receive a functional measurement.
suggested_fix: Review the existing dispatcher admission contract and reports together. Retain distinct source-review, structural-conformance, product-gate and official-functional-score states. Where a declared evaluation contract permits measurement with unresolved source questions, preserve those questions and frozen samples while invoking the unchanged official scorer; do not grant semantic acceptance. Keep strict product signoff blocking. Decide this behavior explicitly before implementation, with neutral positive and negative consumer tests. Never infer a source definition from a historical PASS.
why_not_bucket_a: This is a proposed contract change rather than an established recovery: the program can preserve independent evidence states, but public source plus historical scores cannot establish which assumptions or measurement scope are authorized. Cross-consumer admission behavior and score labels need review and substantive controls before deterministic implementation.
session_context: Post-run evidence comparison only. No candidate or test changed, no official scorer run, and no policy bypass implemented. See adjacent RESULT.md for evidence boundaries and neutral acceptance cases.

title: Reuse source-bound native structural proof in the existing repair lifecycle
pattern: An implementation satisfies binary functional tests but violates an explicit implementation architecture, while a repair API accepts only simulation counterexamples and cannot admit the measured structural defect.
suggested_fix: Reuse the upstream structural-proof work and its existing review lifecycle. Bind source obligation, parent RTL, tool identity, command, abstraction and graph evidence; retain all functional challenges and fresh independent review. An unconstrained equivalent circuit must remain valid; a constrained circuit must meet the declared structure. Verify minimum-count claims under a source-authorized model rather than generic synthesis cell counts alone.
why_not_bucket_a: The gap is assigned to existing upstream work. A deterministic graph check needs an explicit source-owned abstraction and transformation policy; a native cell list cannot itself select that contract. Reuse and validate that implementation before introducing any additional rule.
